sentence: This project maps the nerves that grow into a salivary gland cancer and studies what that nerve growth does as the cancer progresses.
This project tries to grow red blood cells from stem cells to make transfusions safer for patients with sickle cell disease and premature infants.
This project builds a computer pipeline that finds poison exons in long-read transcriptomes of brain organoids grown from stem cells, to study neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project tests whether a drug already approved for another disease can stop collagen from building up in scleroderma, and studies how it works.
This project studies how cells release chemical signals at synapses, a process called exocytosis, using models of membrane fusion.
This project studies whether virus-like elements in the genome start and spread the protein clumping seen in Alzheimer's related dementias, using Drosophila and cell culture.
This project tests whether mistakes in making proteins cause blood-forming stem cells to age, and whether fewer mistakes extend lifespan.
This project tries to find the best way to combine genome, transcriptome and proteome tests to find genetic causes of muscle disease.
This project builds web-based tools that use motion capture data and machine learning to estimate how people move and the forces in their muscles.
This project studies how the aromatase enzyme works and builds tools that can also be used on other cytochromes P450 and membrane proteins.
This project studies how touch-sensing nerve cells in the face detect pain and how they cause trigeminal neuropathic pain.
This project studies the sexual cycle of Pneumocystis, an opportunistic pathogen that infects people with weakened immune systems, including veterans.
This project tries to find out why clinicians disagree on the cause of shock and designs a process for them to share information.
This project studies how somatic, germline and immune cell changes drive treatment resistance in genitourinary cancers, using sequencing and computational methods.
This project studies how estrogen changes the activity of certain brain cells linked to alcohol drinking and anxiety.
This project studies how vaginal microbiome, inflammatory mediators, metabolome and sex hormones relate to dysmenorrhea symptoms.
This project changes sugars on the surface of neural stem cells to help the brain heal after injury in a rodent model.
This project refines brain imaging methods to measure how well the choroid plexus works and how cerebrospinal fluid circulates without surgery.
